versions.changelog: Sprint 9: ERC-8183 Job (escrow) lifecycle. Added 5 Job endpoints (create/get/fund/submit/refund) for A2A service delivery with on-chain USDC escrow. Provider must be a CardZero wallet; CardZero EOA serves as MVP Evaluator. Fees: 2% platform + 5% evaluator.
Add agent-to-agent payment capability to description and docs — A2A is natively supported via existing payment API
Optimize description for ClawHub search discovery — add trigger phrases, x402/Base/micropayment keywords, and Owner-Agent trust model highlights
